lead.en: Build and test a short host-driven automation with a branch.
lead.zh: 创建并测试由宿主驱动、包含分支的短工作流。

rule.en: The host executes steps and resolves matching request IDs. Stop emits Cancel and rejects late responses; Retry resumes the failed step. Branch results must reference a supplied path. The example is simulated and sends nothing. The preview offers Passes, Fails, Loading and Empty scenarios; it sends nothing.
rule.zh: 步骤由宿主执行，并按请求 ID 返回结果；停止会发出取消事件并忽略迟到的响应，重试从失败步骤继续。分支结果必须引用已提供的路径。示例为模拟，不发送任何内容。 预览可切换成功、失败、加载中和空状态，不会发送数据。

api.en: Subscribe to RunStep (which contains Box<WorkflowStep>) and Cancel; call resolve with an output, duration and branch path when applicable. Changed reports editor updates. Provide stable unique step and path IDs. Use set_loading(bool, cx) for a loading skeleton. Loading cancels any pending run. The step picker searches title, app, and detail. Use Up or Down to move, Enter to add, and Escape to close.
api.zh: 订阅 RunStep（包含 Box<WorkflowStep>） 与 Cancel，通过 resolve 提供输出、耗时及分支路径；编辑时发出 Changed。步骤和分支须使用稳定且唯一的 ID。 用 set_loading(bool, cx) 显示加载骨架。进入加载会取消待处理的运行。步骤选择器按标题、应用和描述搜索，上下键移动，回车添加，Esc 关闭。

motion.en: The incoming connector traces for 240 ms. New step results expand to their measured height and fade in over 240 ms. Reduced motion applies the state immediately.
motion.zh: 节点开始时，沿入线移动的标记持续 240ms。新结果在 240ms 内淡入并展开到实测高度。减少动效时直接显示状态。
